name: Dont Question Gods Word
overview: Scripture reveals the unchanging truth and authority of God's Word, affirming that all His works are done in truth and righteousness, as seen in Psalms 33:4. The glory of the LORD is majestic and awe-inspiring, like devouring fire (Exodus 24:17), and His understanding is beyond human comprehension (Isaiah 40:28). God alone is to be praised and honored, refusing to share His glory with any other, including idols (Isaiah 42:8). Therefore, questioning God's Word undermines the very nature of His perfect and sovereign revelation.
